about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a software and hardware engineer with more than 17 years of experience building things that run on phones, servers and microcontrollers. I started in electronics and industrial automation, then moved into mobile, backend and AI-assisted development.
about.p2: I care about clean architecture, tests and reliable delivery. I've led teams, shipped Android and iOS apps to production, worked with international teams under Scrum, and set up CI/CD pipelines.
about.p3: I also enjoy teaching and research: I've taught robotics and electronics, published technical articles, and coach engineers preparing for technical interviews. Robotics remains a passion.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: A selection of what I've built, ordered by relevance. Some were built for clients and their source code is private.

tokenpad.title: Tokenpad — crypto mobile app
tokenpad.desc: Led the team and the development of a Flutter app for iOS and Android with Clean Architecture and TDD. It became a top 10 crypto app by downloads in Latin America. Maintained CI/CD pipelines and code review across a distributed team.

lexipol.title: Lexipol — first responders app
lexipol.desc: Built iOS, Android and web apps with Flutter and Clean Architecture for first responders in the USA. Unit and widget tests, code review and pipelines, with an international team working in Scrum.

headspace.title: Headspace — mobile app
headspace.desc: Senior mobile engineering on the Headspace app as part of a distributed team.

mobe.title: Mobe — co-founded mobile startup
mobe.desc: Made every technical decision and built the product from design to release. It reached more than 500 downloads in about a month and a half.

ram.title: RAM — medical-assistance robot (Covid-19)
ram.desc: Electronics, front end, back end and control code for a robot to assist in patient care during the Covid-19 contingency.

cnc.title: CNC machine for soft materials
cnc.desc: Conversion and technological development of a CNC machine tool for machining soft materials, applying robotics, microcontrollers and control software.

tennis.title: Tennis court scheduling
tennis.desc: Flutter app to schedule and manage tennis court reservations.

hotel.title: Hotel cancellation prediction
hotel.desc: Machine learning analysis and model to predict cancellations in hotel bookings.

digits.title: AI digit recognizer
digits.desc: Handwritten digit recognition with a neural network, developed in a Jupyter notebook.

voting.title: Blockchain voting
voting.desc: Voting smart contract written in Solidity.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Always up for a good conversation about mobile, backend, AI or robotics. The best way to reach me is by email or LinkedIn.
